Yet another PS5 price hike goes into effect next week in all territories. author: IGN
description:
The wait is finally over: Mad Ellie and the Vault of the Damned has officially arrived in Borderlands 4! This massive new expansion brings a hoard of new weapons, high-stakes missions, and the debut of the newest Vault Hunter, C4SH. Whether you’re looking to reunite with Mad Ellie using your endgame build or you want to see if C4SH is your new main, we’ve got you covered on how to jump into the chaos immediately.

In this Borderlands 4 guide, we break down the exact requirements needed to access the Vault of the Damned. We'll show you which mission you need to complete first, where to find the "An Invitation" quest on the Dissected Plateau, and how to use the Level 13 skip to start a brand-new character—including C4SH—straight from the main menu. If you’re skipping the early game, we also highlight how to catch up on the story so you don’t miss a beat of the BL4 narrative.

#ign #gaming
title: Borderlands 4: How to Start the Mad Ellie and the Vault of the Damned DLC

author: IGN
description:
Don't miss the 30th Anniversary Trailer for Jerry Maguire, a romantic comedy drama distributed by Sony Pictures. Witness the tale of a sports agent down on his luck continue the fight for what's right in Jerry Maguire, in theaters on April 12, 14, and 15.

Jerry Maguire follows a successful sports agent who is fired from a high-powered agency when he develops an honorable streak. To his dismay, he finds he has also lost most of his clients and his fiancée, publicist Avery Bishop. With only the least important client on his once-full roster, undersized wide receiver Rod Tidwell, and the one person from his ex-firm who believes in him, wistful single mother Dorothy Boyd, Jerry must start over and rebuild his life from the ground up.

Jerry Maguire stars Tom Cruise, Cuba Gooding, Jr., Renee Zellweger, Kelly Preston, Jerry O’Connell, Jay Mohr, Bonnie Hunt, and more. The film is written and directed by Cameron Crowe, alongside being produced by James L. Brooks, Richard Sakai, Laurence Mark
title: Jerry Maguire - Offical 30th Anniversary Trailer (2026) Tom Cruise, Cuba Gooding Jr.

description:
Check out action-packed gameplay from Exodus in this new video for the upcoming sci-fi RPG. Take a look at Khonsu, a Celestial-built defense platform orbiting your homeworld on Lidon. The new Exodus gameplay clip showcases close-range combat within Khonsu's interior corridors with companions Tom and Elise. We also get to see the Recycler in action, with Repeater mode for ranged encounters and Shredder mode for when enemies close the gap. Additionally, check out the Lance gauntlet ability, which hurls livestone javelins for heavy damage and get a look at Ghosts, ancient Celestial automated defenses that wake up when they detect intruders. 

Exodus will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC in 2027.

Exodus is a sci-fi action-adventure RPG where you become the Traveler—leading humanity’s fight for survival against the Celestials. Face our evolution 40,000 years in the future, explore extraordinary worlds, and confront time itself to shape the fate of generations.​
title: Exodus - Official 'Breaching Khonsu' Gameplay Video

author: IGN
description:
Welcome back to Next-Gen Console Watch! This week Ryan and Max are joined by Logan Plant, host of IGN's Nintendo Voice Chat podcast to talk about the Nintendo Switch 2's Year 1, and what we're expecting for Year 2. The Switch 2 has become not only Nintendo's fastest-selling console, but the fastest-selling console of all-time, with more than 17 million units sold in less than a year. Mario Kart World has a nearly 1:1 attachment rate with the Switch 2, Donkey Kong Bananza was a hit with critics and fans, and Pokémon Pokopia is having an Animal Crossing-esque viral moment. But none of these are Nintendo's major marquee franchises, but does the Switch 2 even need them right now? Plus we have last week's poll results, and a new poll for you to vote on at IGN.com and Spotify.

#IGN #Gaming
title: Switch 2's First Year Was Strong, But Where's Nintendo's Mascots? - Next-Gen Console Watch

description:
What happens when you mix an arcade racer with anime? 
Check out gameplay from Screamer, a High-Octane Anime reimagining of the 1995 racer of the same name. Screamer is an arcade racer that not only has a hyper stylized anime aesthetic, but also features tight and intutive racing mechanics that feel great wether you're going sideways or blasting down the straightaway. This gameplay was captured on PC with all the settings set to epic via an RTX 5090, which means the game runs at 4k with an FPS above 60 thanks in part to DLSS 4 frame generation even with Ray Tracing enabled. 

00:00 - Arcade Race 1
07:14 - Arcade Race 2 
12:21 - Story Mode

#ign #gaming
title: Screamer - Blazing Fast Anime Racing Gameplay
